title: Sparklines inside tables and cards
when: A table, list or stat card needs a tiny trend line next to a number (last 30 days, recent prices).
prompt:
Goal: Word sized SVG sparklines that show shape and the last value, render by the hundred, and have text equivalents.
Steps:
1. viewBox="0 0 100 24" with preserveAspectRatio="none", sized in CSS to 6em by 1.5em so it sits in a line of text.
2. Scale y to the series min and max with 2 units of padding; x by index.
3. A single polyline with a points string, stroke currentColor, width 1.5, vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke.
4. Mark the last point with a small circle.
5. Print the latest value and the change ("+12% vs 30 days ago") as text beside it, with a sign, not color alone.
6. aria-hidden="true" when the text already says the trend, else an aria-label with first, last, min and max; draw a mid line for flat data, skip series under 2 points.
Quality bar:
- Hundreds render fast (one element each).
- Lines stay sharp at any size.
- The number is the message; the line supports it.
Pitfalls:
- Axes or legends on a sparkline.
- Division by zero on flat series.
- Rows with different scales shown as comparable without saying so.
Verify:
- [ ] viewBox and non-scaling stroke.
- [ ] Flat and short series handled.
- [ ] aria-hidden or aria-label on each.
- [ ] Change shown as text.
Output: js/sparkline.js exporting sparkline(values) that returns an svg element for tables or cards.

examples.input: mini gráfico de tendência ao lado de cada ação na tabela
examples.output: sparkline(values) polyline per row, last point dot, "+3.2%" text next to it
